learning_outcomes.text: Write safe concurrent code with threads, channels and Arc/Mutex
Build asynchronous programs with async/await and a runtime
Reason about lifetimes, smart pointers and interior mutability
Use unsafe correctly and document its invariants
Write declarative macros and understand procedural macros
Profile, benchmark and optimise a Rust program
